snippet.title: Scrapborne – Official Trailer | Cyberpunk Text-Based MMO
snippet.description:
Scrapborne Official Trailer

A Helldivers-inspired desktop overlay RPG where your actions shape the universe. Gear up in your bunker and join the galactic struggle from the corner of your screen. Impact the global economy, faction wars, and story. Adapt to World Events in a living, community-driven world. 

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4006570/Scrapborne/

Join the community:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/GStk4eAawh
